---
name: Feature request
about: An analysis, file format, view or workflow EWALD should support
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to do**

The task in your own research (for example "find the Li hops in an AIMD run and plot them per site").

**How you do it today**

Another program, a script, OVITO, VESTA, ...

**Could it be a plugin?**

Readers, modifiers, views and AI tools can all be plugins
(https://github.com/frssp/ewald/blob/main/docs/plugins/index.md). Say if you would like to write it as one.
